description: This file defines a PHPUnit test case class 'ImageAspectRatioTest' that tests the 'ImageAspectRatio' validation rule for image aspect ratio correctness within the OrangeHRM project. It contains a data provider with multiple test cases, verifying the validation logic against images of different aspect ratios.

classes.name: ImageAspectRatioTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the ImageAspectRatio validation rule.

methods.name: testValidate
methods.description: Runs multiple assertions to verify if the ImageAspectRatio validation rule correctly validates images based on aspect ratio, using data provided by 'dataProvider'.

methods.name: dataProvider
methods.description: Provides a set of test cases with different aspect ratios, filenames, MIME types, base64 content, and expected validity to be used by 'testValidate'.
